title: Chemical Drain Cleaners vs. Mechanical Snake
description: Many homeowners believe pouring liquid chemical drain cleaners down a slow drain is a safe, quick fix. In reality, caustic chemicals generate exothermic reactions that can soften schedule 40 PVC pipes, degrade rubber seals, and corrode older cast iron lines. Furthermore, chemicals often fail to clear full blockages, standing in the pipe and creating a hazard for plumbers who must service the drain later. Professional plumbers rely on mechanical cleaning tools, such as drain augers or hydro-jetters, to physically remove obstructions without damaging pipe walls or compromising system integrity.

Chemical Drain Cleaners vs. Mechanical Snake

Many homeowners believe pouring liquid chemical drain cleaners down a slow drain is a safe, quick fix. In reality, caustic chemicals generate exothermic reactions that can soften schedule 40 PVC pipes, degrade rubber seals, and corrode older cast iron lines. Furthermore, chemicals often fail to clear full blockages, standing in the pipe and creating a hazard for plumbers who must service the drain later. Professional plumbers rely on mechanical cleaning tools, such as drain augers or hydro-jetters, to physically remove obstructions without damaging pipe walls or compromising system integrity.
